fresh_source_evidence.fact: Current INSPIRE Index Polygons release is published 5 July 2026 and remains available until the next monthly update.
INSPIRE Index Polygon files are updated on the first Sunday of each month.
INSPIRE polygons are published by local authority as GML under Open Government Licence conditions.
INSPIRE polygons show indicative position and extent rather than definitive registered-title boundaries.
HMLR geometry is captured against British National Grid and reprojection to WGS84 can shift features by up to 15 metres.
LIDAR Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England at 1m spatial resolution.
The DTM removes surface objects to represent bare-earth terrain.
For repeat surveys the newest best-resolution data is used and bilinear interpolation is used where resampling is needed.
LIDAR Composite DTM 1m uses EPSG:27700 and published vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE.
The persistent LIDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS supports WCS 2.0.1.
Metadata survey-index services identify the survey contributing to a location.
OS Terrain 50 is Open Data, supplied in 10km tiles with 50m grid spacing and updated annually in July.
OS Terrain 50 grid height points are verified to 4m RMSE.
The current OS Terrain 50 known-data-issues page reports no live known data issues.
